regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, non-directional rotation led by AI Compute & Optics, but the detector's own backtest verdict says the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market (gate_helps=false) and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is weak/insignificant. Mean-reverting tape whipsaws the gate, so I treat every lean as low-conviction and heavily conditioned on plain observable checks.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (rank 2, uncrowded, trend-tagged, but ineligible) crosses into eligibility with a durability_bar above 0.4; that would retire this watch and mark a confirmed handoff away from the one-narrative AI leader.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Top rank, eligible, uncrowded, and highest durability_bar (0.52) among eligible themes. Breadth (0.353) is moderate, not a blow-off, and crowding_z is negative. This is the prevailing narrative, so a lean in its direction is consistent with trend-following discipline even though momentum is not return-forecasting alpha.
theses.dissent: gate_helps=false here means the trend gate failed to cut drawdown on this mean-reverting tape, so an eligible leader can whipsaw hard; momentum rank has ~0 forward IC, so top rank is attention, not edge.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS falls below CSI 300 by more than 5% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Eligible, trend-tagged, uncrowded, with the highest durability_bar (0.58) of any eligible theme and healthy breadth (0.364). It sits adjacent to the AI Compute leader without being extended, making it a structurally stronger trend candidate than the leader itself.
theses.dissent: Score is well below the leader and challenger margin is wide; on a mean-reverting tape strong trend-tags can be a lagging indicator that arrives just before the whipsaw.

falsifier.text: 512760.SS breaks below its own 20-day low before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Crowding flag (crowded=true, crowding_z=1.58) is a size-down caution, not a fade, and with durability_bar only 0.63 on a mixed Hurst tag, the theme lacks a clean trend regime. Given the gate already failed to help on this market, the crowding caution argues for standing aside rather than leaning in.
theses.dissent: Banks have the widest breadth (0.722) of any theme and rank 4, so participation is broad; the crowding flag is coincident and does not predict a drawdown.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS makes a new 20-day high with breadth staying above 0.7 before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
